Adds a metallib-freshness guard. This runner returns from --local-cool-gate-only long before benchmark.sh's own rebuild at benchmark.sh:1773, so a kernel edit made after the last ./setup.sh was being timed against the PREVIOUS mlx.metallib -- silently, and in the one direction that hurts: a real decode change reads as noise and a correctness-breaking one never executes. The guard reuses benchmark.sh's own RUNTIME_WORKER_BIN / MLX_METALLIB / metallib_rebuild_required definitions rather than restating them, so the two cannot drift apart.
overlays.obligation: The guard must stay FAIL-CLOSED. Its own extraction can fail silently -- an awk pattern that stops matching emits nothing, eval "" succeeds, metallib_rebuild_required is left undefined, `if metallib_rebuild_required` exits 127, set -e exempts an if condition, and the branch reads FALSE, skipping the very rebuild the block exists to force. So the pinned token is the `declare -F` assertion itself, not a comment marker. This overlay can only ABORT a local timing run; it can never make a number look better, and it does not touch the scored harness, which the organizer runs from their own tree. Behavioural coverage lives in research/metallib-guard-controls.sh.
